Resources

* Documentation
* Listing in Anthropic’s directory

What the PitchBook Premium connector does

The PitchBook MCP server connects PitchBook's private-capital database — 8.5 million private companies, 2.8 million deals, 597,000 investors and 154,000 funds — to Claude and other AI platforms. Anthropic's directory lists 16 tools, every one a read. Access needs an existing PitchBook licence and SSO, and is capped at 300 tool calls a day.
Verified connector
Listed by Anthropic as a partner connector in its Connectors Directory .
Connection checked by Agentman on 22 August 2026 .
Anthropic states this reflects the level of review a connector received, not a security audit.

PitchBook Premium tools (16)

* pitchbook_search
* pitchbook_get_profile

...

* pitchbook_get_call_transcripts_analysis
* pitchbook_get_private_market_reports_analysis
* pitchbook_get_public_market_reports_analysis
* pitchbook_get_help_center_analysis
Tool names from Anthropic's directory listing. This server requires sign-in, so we could not read tool descriptions or parameter schemas.

Limits

* 150 tool calls per hour and 300 per day. PitchBook's published caps, counted per call rather than per conversation. No Retry-After behaviour, 429 semantics or cap-exhaustion message is documented, and no tool reports remaining quota.
* No application scopes exist. The RFC 9728 descriptor and the authorization server metadata both advertise exactly three scopes — openid , offline_access and claudeai . Two are identity and refresh; the third names a client, not a capability. There is no scope boundary between a company lookup and an LP commitment list , which is the boundary a reviewer of this dataset would most want. PitchBook states access is "tied to each user's permissions", so narrowing happens in its own entitlement model, invisibly to the consent screen.
* The integration excludes some third-party data. Anthropic's tutorial states it "excludes some proprietary 3rd-party data included in the PitchBook platform" without naming which, so a figure present in the web platform can be absent here.

...

* The main help centre is login-gated. help.pitchbook.com , which Anthropic's directory nominates as documentation, redirects every route to a Salesforce SAML sign-in. The public mirror at pitchbook.com/help carries the connector articles cited here; the two hosts are not interchangeable.
* No prompts or resources could be enumerated. Anthropic's directory records no prompt names, and the authentication gate prevented us from reading the server's declared capabilities.

Frequently asked questions

How many PitchBook queries can an agent make per day?

Three hundred, with a ceiling of 150 in any 60-minute window. PitchBook publishes both figures as tool calls rather than conversations, so one question that checks a company, its investors and its deals spends three. That is the number to plan around, because the connector's own relationship-mapping use case chains four hops.

Do I need a PitchBook subscription to use the MCP server?

Yes, plus a paid Claude plan. PitchBook states you need a seat-based, unlimited, or trial PitchBook licence and single sign-on credentials, and a Pro, Max, Teams or Enterprise Claude subscription. The endpoint returned an authentication challenge to an anonymous request on 2026-08-22, so there is no unauthenticated access.

Can the PitchBook connector change anything in my account?

No. All 16 tool names begin with search or get, none carries a create, update, delete or export verb, and Anthropic's directory records the connector's permissions as Read. No tool takes a method or action argument that could forward to a wider API, so the read-only reading survives the dispatcher check.

...

What OAuth permissions does the PitchBook MCP server request?

Three, and none is an application permission. The server's RFC 9728 descriptor advertised openid, offline_access and claudeai on 2026-08-22. The first two are identity and refresh scopes; claudeai names a client rather than a capability. Narrowing happens in PitchBook's own per-user entitlements, not at the consent screen.

Should I set the PitchBook connector to always allow?

PitchBook recommends it and the tools are all reads, but weigh it against the daily cap. Every call is metered against 150 an hour and 300 a day, and an approval prompt is the only thing that shows an agent spending that budget on a multi-hop chain. Nothing in the surface reports remaining quota.

What data does the PitchBook connector not include?

...

# PitchBook API Documentation

## Introduction

The PitchBook API allows for direct, real time access to our expansive database of Companies, Deals, People, Investors, Fund, Service Provider and Limited Partner information. Power your own custom applications and CRM systems with the industry’s best data.

This API is a RESTFUL implementation that can be easily accessed by most HTTP clients in the language of your choosing.

To get started with the PitchBook API, there are a few simple steps.

##### **Step 1: Check out our test "Sandbox"**

To help developers get comfortable with the PitchBook API, a test "sandbox" environment has been created to show how API calls are structured and how to integrate them with your system. Please reach out to your account manager to request a sandbox key.

##### **Step 2: Review the API contract**

The API is a separate offering from the PitchBook platform that requires a standalone contract agreement. Please note that not all endpoints included here are necessarily included in a subscription - contact your PitchBook representative for specifics on what you have licensed. This will also be laid out within your contract.

##### **Step 3: Estimate usage and credits required**

Each request for data to the API will have an associated credit cost. After determining the scope of the data your application will need, both the developer “sandbox” and your Customer Success Manager can help you select a subscription package that fits the best.

##### **Step 4: Purchase credits**

Once you have estimated your API credit requirements, reach out to your Customer Success Manager to be invoiced for the required dollar amount. After payment has been settled, the API credits will be added to your account for immediate use.

##### **Step 5. Get your data**

PitchBook will provide you with a unique API key that will allow you to make calls to the API. Your developer can use this key to retrieve our data and start powering your application. Your Customer Success Manager can help answer any questions about getting started with the API or the developer test "sandbox".

## Authentication

To authenticate to the PitchBook API, simply include a header named "Authorization" with the value of "PB-Token {API\_KEY}" with each API request.

Replace {API\_KEY} with your actual API key value.

In addition to an API key, please make sure you have purchased API credits. Each call has a defined cost. Reach out to your account manager to view and add credits to your API credit balance.

**Authentication Example**

> [api.pitchbook.com/{route}](api-v2.pitchbook.com/%7Broute%7D)  
> Authorization: PB-Token LzUU9xgNjn7avDw5Bd96xNVS0t5dlGuD
> 
> 

**Base URL (production and sandbox)**

[api.pitchbook.com](api-v2.pitchbook.com/)

## Response Codes

PitchBook API returns standard HTTP response codes for every request. The HTTP error or success codes that may be returned are listed below.

View More

|Code |Title |Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
|200 |OK |Standard response description for successful HTTP request |
|400 |Bad Request |The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing) |
|400 |Bad Request |Results per page must be between 1 and {PER\_PAGE\_LIMIT} |
|401 |Unauthorized |Please check your Authorization header value |
|402 |Payment Required |Insufficient credit balance limits. Credit balance = {CURRENT\_CREDIT\_BALANCE}, call cost = {ENDPOINT\_COST} |
|403 |Forbidden |Permission denied. You do not have access to {ENDPOINT} |
|404 |Not Found |No {REQUEST\_PROFILE\_TYPE} found |
|405 |Method Not Allowed |A request method is not supported for the requested resource |
|415 |Unsupported Media Type |Supportable media types: {SUPPORTED\_TYPE} |
|429 |Too Many Requests |{LIMIT\_TYPE} rate limit exceeded. Please wait until rate limit period is renewed |
|503 |Service Unavailable |{REQUESTED\_DATA\_TYPE} data is temporarily unavailable due to service maintenance or a capacity issue. Please try again later |

## Headers

The PitchBook API can accept headers, for example, to default values to a specific currency.

**X-Currency:** Converts values returned as currencies (e.g. totalMoneyRaised) to the currency specified. (e.g. USD, JPY). See the lookup table CURRENCY\_CODE for the full list of available currencies.

# The private capital financial research platform

## Trusted by

## Platform

PitchBook brings together private market data, research, workflow tools, AI-powered insights, and integrations in one platform. From sourcing deals and researching companies to benchmarking funds and planning exits, teams can access the data and tools they need to move faster, work smarter, and make more confident decisions.

Integrations help teams bring private market data directly into the tools they already use, from Excel and PowerPoint to CRM systems. With real-time data, dynamic updates, and enriched company, deal, and contact insights, teams can streamline workflows, reduce manual work, and create more accurate models, presentations, and outreach strategies faster.

Lumonic helps teams manage private market portfolios by bringing unstructured data, market signals, and reporting workflows into one connected solution. By consolidating spreadsheets, PDFs, APIs, and portal exports, teams can turn fragmented information into actionable insights, track performance, identify trends, and build dashboards that support faster, more confident portfolio decisions.

Direct Data puts PitchBook company, deal, and fund data inside your own systems and data warehouses. Pull specific data points on demand through the API, or receive a scheduled feed delivered to your cloud platform or database. Your team stops collecting data and starts working with it.

PitchBook’s AI learning capabilities help teams accelerate research, uncover insights, and make more confident decisions using trusted private market data. By combining advanced AI with human insights and authoritative research, PitchBook supports faster workflows, reliable analysis, and smarter decision-making across the private capital markets.

sources.trimmed:
## Overview

PitchBook’s API solution allows you to call specific PitchBook data into your internal business systems on demand. This flexible solution means you have access to PitchBook’s expansive database. It’s the ideal integration for CRM enrichment, allowing you to extract data on an ad-hoc basis that meets the needs of your organization.

You can explore a specific entity and retrieve valuable data, and the API solution enables you to apply specific criteria, such as location and industry, to drill down into the businesses you discover.

## Use cases

The API is a good solution if:

* Your scope and data points are subject to change frequently.
* You require a near-instant population of data.
* You perform ad-hoc research.
* You want to see past and present financial data.
* RESTful API is a system requirement.

## How the API works

**Accessing the API**

The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser. Every call will use the same base URL: https://api.pitchbook.com

**Available data points**

The API solution offers a variety of relational endpoints, including financing details, deal stock information, as well as AI-powered VC exit predictor data. See the full list from our API Endpoints Overview document.

**Create your API connection**

To start your API connection, you will need to send a request directly to our Direct Data team through this link.

Or if you’re a PitchBook client, you can also head to the Plugins & Apps section from the My PitchBook section of the left-hand sidebar on the PitchBook Platform and choose PitchBook API.

From this section on the platform, you can test specific endpoints. This section on PitchBook also allows you to reach out to our Direct Data team to request access to the API.

## 

## Next steps

Our team will work with you to understand the insights and data you’re looking for and help you establish the API connection through an API key or authentication token. Available data for each entity type is packaged across several endpoints so you can map the data to your desired format and structure.

### Experience the PitchBook Platform firsthand

Discover how PitchBook’s leading tools and capabilities can strengthen your due diligence workflows.

## Overview

As we rely on AI tools to move faster and make smarter decisions, switching between tools to find data can be time-consuming. PitchBook’s Premium Connector solves this by integrating PitchBook data directly into the AI platforms you already use. With secure access, you can query private market insights without disrupting workflow. In this article, learn how our Premium Connector works and which AI platforms we partner with.

## How it works

The Premium Connector provides a secure link between PitchBook and AI tools. Once connected, you can use your AI tool to access a wide range of PitchBook’s private market data directly. By specifying **“**Using PitchBook data as the source**”** in your query, you ensure the response includes only PitchBook’s verified proprietary data.

When a question is sent, the connector translates it into a query that PitchBook can pr

## Workflow

This section outlines the general workflow for using the Premium Connector. While setup may vary slightly across different AI partners, the core process follows these steps:

* **Setup** – AI partners connect securely to PitchBook’s Premium Connector (built on MCP server technology) directly through the partner’s site. There’s no need for local installation or custom integration as the connection is managed in the cloud, allowing quick deployment.

# PitchBook Announces New Essential MCP Integration with Perplexity, Expanding Access to AI-Powered, Verifiable Market Intelligence

*Perplexity users can now surface PitchBook’s industry-trusted firmographic data with full source attribution*

**SEATTLE — March 12, 2026 —** PitchBook, the leading private capital market intelligence platform, today announced a new partnership with Perplexity, the leading AI-answer engine. Through Perplexity’s new PitchBook Essential MCP server, users can now access PitchBook’s trusted firmographic intelligence directly within Perplexity’s conversational interface.

AI adoption continues to accelerate across financial services, but the ability to ask questions and receive answers powered by high-quality, comprehensive data is what drives better decision making and delivers meaningful ROI. PitchBook’s AI and machine learning strategy centers on pairing advanced technology with human insight to create one of the most comprehensive and dependable private market datasets in the industry. Perplexity’s answer engine retrieves and synthesizes information from authoritative sources in real-time, delivering citied, verifiable answers that are crucial for high-stakes financial decisions. Through this Essential Partner integration, Perplexity users can ask complex questions about companies and deals and receive clear, sourced insights supported by PitchBook’s intelligence.

“Together, PitchBook and Perplexity are expanding access to private market intelligence,” said Tom Van Buskirk, EVP of Technology & Engineering at PitchBook. “AI is most effective when it’s powered by the most accurate, high-quality data. Perplexity’s conversational interface opens new ways
...
lligence into Perplexity’s conversational interface, we’re enabling new ways to explore private markets, where professionals can conduct deep research, ask follow-up questions, and uncover connections they might not have found through traditional search.”

The Perplexity integration marks the latest milestone in PitchBook’s expanding network of AI partnerships, which include Anthropic, FarsightAI, Finster, Hebbia, Model ML, OpenAI, Rogo, and Writer. Together, these collaborations extend PitchBook’s intentional approach to working across the AI ecosystem, extending access to trusted private market intelligence wherever professionals choose to work.

To learn more about PitchBook’s AI capabilities and partnerships, click here.

**About PitchBook, a Morningstar company** As the pulse of private capital markets, PitchBook delivers trusted, real-time data, research, and technology to help investors, dealmakers, and innovators make decisions with confidence. Its products provide comprehensive information on companies, investors, funds, deals, and people, along with tools that help professionals analyze market activity and make informed decisions. To start your API connection, you will need to send a request directly to our Direct Data team [through this link.](pitchbook.com/products/direct-access-data?adgroup=&device=c&_bk=pitchbook&_bt=692687660336&_bm=e&_bn=g&_bg=159619233076&kwdaud=kwd-334479000139&sfid=-dc_pcrid_692687660336_pkw_pitchbook_pmt_e_slid__p…)

Or if you’re a PitchBook client, you can also head to the Plugins & Apps section from the My PitchBook section of the left-hand sidebar on the PitchBook Platform and choose PitchBook API.
